leaves.name: modularHTCoeff
leaves.doc: R13, printed existence form over a finite coefficient field (htnew-assembly): for a prime l, embeddings iota_C, iota_L and a Tau Ceti newform f of weight k >= 2 and level N (every level, l | N included), there are a finite extension E of Q_l inside Qbar_l (the print's K_{f,lambda} / Kato's F_lambda, embedded) and a continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(E), unramified outside N l, with either (arithmetic Frobenius trace a_p and Hodge-Tate weights {0, k-1}, cyclotomic weight +1) or (geometric Frobenius trace a_p and Hodge-Tate weights {0, k-1}, cyclotomic weight -1), the multiplicity of w being dim_E (V tensor_{Q_l} C_l(-+w))^{G_{Q_l}} (Mathlib tensor product, the print's definition). Replaces modularHTPrinted: the assembly lemma dim_E (V tensor C_l(w))^G = htMult(rho dual, -w) (trace-form isomorphism V tensor C_l = Hom(E^n, C_l)), HTDual and the coefficient extension E in Qbar_l are proved in Lean (ModularHTCoeff.lean).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (existence form over the print's coefficient field K_{f,lambda} / F_lambda, Hodge-Tate weights 0, k-1 in the print's tensor-product definition, every level; the four normalization/sign-convention readings reduce to the two disjuncts in Lean; trace clause only); locator UNVERIFIED
